name: 11785-sharedimage-vl4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, bf16, ungated. ~8 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1 -- no tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=1.0 req/s, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: One user turn over /v1/chat/completions holding a constant 5-word instruction, then a fixed 1280x704 JPEG byte-identical on every request, then a freshly synthesized 1280x704 JPEG. Each image is 40x22 = 880 vision tokens, so a prompt is ~1.8k tokens; 128 output tokens pinned exactly; seed 42.
purpose: A four-billion-parameter vision assistant answering a short instruction about two photos per request, one request per second, single GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit e7b09efc0a40d04951c025cb9230fc171a738fff (v0.5.6.post2-439-ge7b09efc0a4).
#
# HAZARD: flat `key: value` only. The reader takes this file line by line and skips indented
# lines, so a nested block is DROPPED and the engine runs without the setting declared here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: -1
random-seed: 42
